title: Substance objects: singular partitive
focus: Choose singular partitive for an unspecified amount of food or drink.

exercises.prompt: An unspecified amount.Complete “I drink coffee.” Juon ____.
exercises.explanation: An unspecified amount of a substance uses singular partitive as the object, the thing the action concerns. This i-word keeps i: kahvi + a = kahvia. The back vowel a determines the ending.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Substance objects: singular partitive: form or use confused
